name: yerlab
description: YerLab — Telegram Mini App helping people in Uzbekistan get more value from their land.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @yerlab/api" "npm run dev -w @yerlab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @yerlab/types && npm run build -w @yerlab/api && npm run build -w @yerlab/web
